name: Quantdeal
postCreateCommand: pip install curl_cffi patchright playwright && pip install -r requirements.txt && patchright install chromium && playwright install --with-deps chromium
postStartCommand: pg_isready || pg_ctlcluster 16 main start && psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE quantdeal;' 2>/dev/null; psql -U postgres -d quantdeal -f sql/schema.sql 2>/dev/null
